{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABejFKIQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIEJrw", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 326, "title": "Automatically request persistent storage on model download and remove Models storage-management section", "body": "## Goal

Automatically request persistent browser storage when model assets are downloaded for the first time, and remove the entire **Storage and cache management** section from the **Models** page. Users should not have to understand or manually request persistent storage to manage AI models.

Treat persistence as a **best-effort safeguard against browser storage eviction**, not a prerequisite for downloading or a guarantee that downloaded files will never be deleted.

## Current implementation

- [`extension/model-cache.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.html) contains an expandable **Storage and cache management** section, status `#persistence`, and **Request persistent storage** button `#persist`. It also contains longer storage/cache explanations and license/source links.
- [`extension/model-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.js) wires that button and status through `showPersistence(request)`, and invokes `storagePersistence(navigator.storage, request)`.
- [`extension/model-asset-cache.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-asset-cache.js) implements `storagePersistence()` with `navigator.storage.persisted()` / `navigator.storage.persist()`, and `ModelAssetCache.prepare()` for normal downloadable models.

## Requested behavior

1. **Automatically make a best-effort persistent-storage request** on the extension origin when the first model asset download is about to begin. The trigger must cover both manual **Download / retry** in Models and automatic model preparation after a graph is saved. When multiple requests/downloads happen concurrently, coordinate them so one first-time request suffices rather than spamming duplicate calls.
2. If persistence is already granted, skip the request. Avoid repeatedly requesting persistence after a denial during normal downloads within the same running origin/session. If unavailable, unsupported, denied, or throwing an exception, proceed with ordinary model downloading/caching without interruption.
3. **Do not request persistence just from opening Models, opening Graph Editor, inspecting/checking a cache, loading a graph, or using a model-free graph.** Do not create a new permission UI or require a gesture/button press specifically for this request.
4. Keep the actual download, checksum/hash verification, cancellation, retries, shared cache, cache eviction recovery, and model deletion flows unchanged. Requesting persistence must not be misrepresented as protecting files from intentional user deletion, extension uninstall, or all data loss.
5. **Remove the entire expandable `Storage and cache management` block** from Models, including its long explanatory paragraphs, `#persistence` and `#persist` UI/button and the now-unneeded page-specific handler. Do not add an equivalent manual storage-control block elsewhere.
6. **Preserve legally relevant information** currently inside that block. Move links/attributions for Supertonic and Kokoro weights/voices, TTS terms/notices, matching eSpeak NG source/build bundle and any other required licensing details into appropriate existing model-card license sections and/or a compact legal notices area. Preserve their URL targets and ensure they remain discoverable without the removed storage section. Keep other existing footer legal notices.
7. Put the persistence trigger in the common download/preparation layer where possible, not only in Models-page UI. Audit model families' preparation paths, especially as [#323](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/323) migrates bundled ReazonSpeech/Silero models to the unified downloadable lifecycle.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] First actual model download makes a best-effort `navigator.storage.persist()` request, after checking `persisted()`, with no required user interaction.
- [ ] The request is coordinated across concurrent download starts; repeated downloads do not prompt/request unnecessarily.
- [ ] Unsupported/denied/error results do **not** prevent download, caching, verification, model preparation or runtime use.
- [ ] Merely viewing Models, checking cache, editing a model-free graph, or opening a model-free Live does not trigger the request.
- [ ] Models page has no **Storage and cache management** disclosure, **Request persistent storage** button, or orphaned status/placeholder.
- [ ] Model cards retain their download/status/check/delete functionality.
- [ ] Required license/notice/source links formerly contained in the removed panel remain available in logical places.
- [ ] Automated tests cover success, already granted, denied, unsupported, exceptions, repeat/concurrent calls, manual and Auto Save preparation, and DOM removal.
- [ ] No unrelated model, asset-loading or browser permission behavior changes.

## Touchpoints

- `extension/model-asset-cache.js`: reusable persistence helper and shared download trigger, safe best-effort handling; make concurrency robust.
- `extension/model-cache.js`: remove manual persistence UI event wiring.
- `extension/model-cache.html`: delete entire disclosure and relocate required license/notice links.
- `extension/models.css` / other styles only if obsolete selectors or spacing exist.
- Model cache/asset preparation tests, Models page browser tests, documentation.

## Related issues

- [#323](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/323): all models, including former bundled models, use the same download/cache lifecycle. Ensure automatic persistence applies to this unified pipeline.
- [#324](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/324): removes redundant introduction and assets heading from Models; together the page should simply show model cards beneath its header.
- [#319](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/319): Models header navigation simplification.

## Out of scope

- A global cache purge, change in the browser's storage quota, or a guarantee against data eviction.
- New mandatory permission dialogs or a new settings page.
- Changing the model registry, inference logic, or model packaging beyond coordination with #323.
